source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current HTTP body setup copies data with SetByteStringData. Its SAFETY comment explains that the channel travels to Response but the request body does not, so ShareData could leave a dangling buffer and AdoptData could create two owners. This confirms the already captured fetch-adapter copying lesson in a distinct HTTP owner. Optimize only with an explicit lifetime/ownership design, not a local borrowed pointer. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep request stream data alive across the response channel lifetime
